question: Can we safely and usefully begin NON-score-bearing engineering qualification (S1a)?
separate_from_n4: This gate is separate from the S1-readiness gate N4 (fo_s1_readiness_gate: scripts/experiments/s1_readiness.py, docs/experiments/s1_readiness/), which is not modified and stays S1_NOT_READY 0/8. authority.rule: The gate evaluates only while the four owner decision files exist unaltered: each byte-identical to the sha256 pinned here; the original APPROVED and decided by the owner; each addendum decided by the owner, naming the original in 'amends', with amends_sha256 equal to the sha256 of the original on disk. The S1a scope is read from A3 next_execution.S1a_engineering_gate and must equal owner_text verbatim; every condition's owner_clause must be a verbatim substring of that text; every quote below must be a verbatim substring of its field. If anything fails, the authority fails closed and the verdict is S1A_NOT_READY.

owner_text.text: a separate gate answering 'can we safely and usefully begin non-score-bearing engineering qualification?'; N4 (S1_NOT_READY 0/8) is not modified. S1a requires only the hardware needed for calibration/shakedown, safe operational limits, released ground-qualification feed points, frozen calibration procedures and an engineering facility; it explicitly forbids held-out H-1 physics outputs from leaking into W5

gate_semantics.rule: S1A_READY only if the authority holds and every condition (S1A-C1..S1A-C5 and the mandatory data firewall S1A-FW) is SATISFIED. The firewall fails closed: if S1A-FW is not SATISFIED (missing, draft, invalid or ambiguous) the verdict is S1A_NOT_READY whatever else holds, and every rule that cross-checks against the firewall (member_of_artifact) fails too. Otherwise S1A_NOT_READY, listing every unsatisfied condition with its expected artifact(s), the failed checks and the producer.

condition_states.SATISFIED: an artifact exists at an expected path and passes every rule
condition_states.MISSING: no artifact exists at any expected path
condition_states.REJECTED_DRAFT: a 'status', 'decision' or 'flight_status' field ANYWHERE in the artifact (top level or nested) contains DRAFT, PROPOSED or PENDING; such an artifact never satisfies a condition, whatever else it contains
condition_states.INVALID: the artifact exists but fails one or more rules (the failures are listed)
condition_states.AMBIGUOUS: an artifact exists at more than one candidate location (the gate never chooses between them)

availability.PARTIAL_PRECURSORS_ONLY: one or more precursor drafts exist in the repository; precursors are reported for orientation and NEVER satisfy a condition

never: infer or fill a condition by assumption
accept a DRAFT, PROPOSED or PENDING artifact
treat S1A_READY as S1 readiness (N4) or as authority to take score-bearing or Hall-on H-1 data
read an artifact outside the repository or follow a reference outside it
gate_semantics.draft_status_scope: recursive: every object at every depth, including list items
gate_semantics.date_format: ISO 8601 calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, optionally followed by THH:MM[:SS]Z (UTC); the date and time must exist (e.g. 2026-13-45 is rejected)
gate_semantics.sha256_ref_format: an object {"path": <repository-relative path>, "sha256": <64 lowercase hex>}; the gate recomputes the sha256 of the file on disk and requires equality

rule_types.is_true: field is the JSON boolean true
rule_types.is_bool: field is a JSON boolean (true or false); the value is recorded, not judged
rule_types.iso_date: field is a valid (existing) date in date_format
rule_types.nonempty_string: field is a non-empty string that does not start with 'TBD' (case-insensitive)
rule_types.quantity: field is {value, unit, source, evidence_class}: value a finite number (or an object of numbers), unit and source non-empty non-TBD strings, evidence_class one of measured / digitized / inferred / reconstructed / model-derived / assumed (docs/EVIDENCE.md)
rule_types.sha256_ref: field is a sha256 reference to a file inside the repository whose sha256 matches; optional path_equals pins the path; optional path_prefix requires it under a directory; optional artifact_of pins it to the uniquely resolved artifact of another condition
rule_types.covers: field is a list of objects whose key values include every entry of required
rule_types.each_item: field is a non-empty list and every item passes rules
rule_types.any_item: field is a non-empty list and at least one item passes rules
rule_types.member_of_artifact: field value is one of the key values of list_field in the artifact of condition artifact_of; that condition must itself be SATISFIED (used to tie S1a calibration procedures to the firewall's allowed data classes; fails closed if the firewall is not satisfied)
rule_types.field_paths: a field may be a dotted path into nested objects (e.g. facility.name)

conditions.task_statement: hardware needed for calibration/shakedown available and identified (serial numbers); H-1 need not be the frozen qualification configuration but its configuration must be recorded
conditions.why: S1a runs the no-plasma calibrations of lane 25 s1_plan.S1a_no_plasma (power-analyzer channels M2, thrust-stand in-situ calibration M1, MFC and gauge calibrations M9/M10, B(z) maps at the operating coil currents M11) and the W4 capability-demonstration procedures (fo_capability_demo_prep CD-01..CD-07). Engineering data are only useful if every unit is identified and its configuration is recorded; a B(z) map on an unrecorded magnetic circuit or a thrust-stand calibration with an unrecorded service-line bundle is not reusable.

conditions.owner_clause: it explicitly forbids held-out H-1 physics outputs from leaking into W5
conditions.task_statement: mandatory data firewall: S1a data may never expose held-out H-1 physics outputs to W5; allowed and forbidden/embargoed quantities, custody rule and OUTPUTS_SEEN consequence per W5; the gate fails closed if the firewall artifact is missing
conditions.why: S1a produces the first H-1 data. A1 C1: before any H-1 data exist the experiment is partitioned into calibration/registration data and held-out prediction data. A2 data rule: no experimental data is used for model promotion until the W5 pre-registration is frozen. The W5 draft (docs/validation/hall_transport_v2_prereg/) classifies I_d, thrust, sustainment/extinction, oscillations, species, ion energy and T_e/n_e as HELD_OUT (VO-ID, VO-T, VO-IGNEXT, VO-OSC, VO-SPECIES, VO-IEDF, VO-TENE), divergence as a registration observation operator measurable only in Hall-on readings (VO-DIV), and B(z), geometry and feed state as registration inputs released only after LOCK-H1 (sequence K1/K2). Its publication_rule makes a disclosure of an embargoed value before PF-1 is frozen AUTOMATICALLY flag the affected conditions OUTPUTS_SEEN (TARGET_NOT_ADMISSIBLE_OUTPUTS_SEEN -> candidate INCONCLUSIVE, not FAIL). W5 classes no Hall-on reading as S1a calibration or registration (S1b dispersion statistics only, after S1a).

firewall_reference_classes.status: PROPOSED content for the owner's firewall artifact (orientation only; the gate checks the artifact, never this block)

allowed.CALIBRATION: calibration constants and their uncertainty for thrust stand, power channels (incl. the I_d / V_d channels calibrated without plasma), MFCs, gauges, B(z) probe, temperature channels, DAQ
allowed.NOISE: channel noise floors with no plasma
allowed.DRIFT: zero and span drift with no plasma (thermal settling of the stand, gauge drift)
allowed.REPEATABILITY: repeatability of calibrations and of B(z) maps at fixed coil current (CD-05)
allowed.REINSTALLATION: no-plasma installation / re-installation reproducibility (CD-02a); the Hall-on re-mount series CD-02b is S1b (N4), not S1a
allowed.CHANNEL_PERFORMANCE: bandwidth, synchronization and time-base performance of the DAQ and power channels (CD-06) with test signals, no plasma
allowed.QUALITATIVE_RGA: uncalibrated RGA spectra used qualitatively (A3 decisions.near_cathode_rga); never an exposure-dose or lifetime claim
allowed.FACILITY_BACKGROUND: no-plasma base pressure, residual-gas composition and cold-flow facility pressure at the released feed points

firewall_reference_classes.registration_inputs_measured_in_S1a: REG-GEOM (as-built metrology), REG-BZ (B(z) at actual coil currents), REG-FEED (calibrated feed setpoints): measured in S1a, held by the custodian, released to the physics track only after LOCK-H1 (W5 K1/K2); a B(z)-vs-magnetic-circuit comparison is a magnetics check, never transport-validation evidence (W5 VO-BZ)

forbidden_or_embargoed.VO-DIV: divergence (a registration observation operator, but only measurable Hall-on)
forbidden_or_embargoed.HW0-PBUS-HALL-ON: HW-0 P_bus at a Hall-on reading
forbidden_or_embargoed.HW0-KNEE: the Phase-1 knee mdot_knee and the OP2/OP2H identity derived from it
forbidden_or_embargoed.H1-ANY-HALL-OPERATING-POINT: any H-1 anode discharge (H-1 anode, C-1 and MC-1 energized together) at any condition; W5 classes none as S1a calibration or registration

firewall_reference_classes.consequence: W5 custody_and_blinding.publication_rule.automatic_flag and leak_rule: any exposure of an embargoed value outside the custody circle before PF-1 is hash-frozen flags every affected F1/F2/F3/F6 condition OUTPUTS_SEEN (TARGET_NOT_ADMISSIBLE_OUTPUTS_SEEN -> candidate INCONCLUSIVE, not FAIL); the flag does not depend on showing the value reached the physics track. W5 defines no automatic flag for a registration input released before LOCK-H1; such a release breaks W5 K1 and needs an owner disposition (PROPOSED).

relation.N4: N4 (fo_s1_readiness_gate) decides whether S1 (S1a no-plasma calibration + S1b Hall-on re-mount qualification per lane 25 s1_plan) may be scheduled after LOCK-1; it stays S1_NOT_READY 0/8 and is not modified. S1a here is the engineering path the owner opened in A3: it may begin before LOCK-1, never takes a Hall-on H-1 reading, is never score-bearing, and never satisfies an N4 condition by itself. Its records can later become N4 evidence only through the N4 artifacts (e.g. the S1-C4 capability-demonstration record from S1a calibration measurements, accepted by the owner under the frozen S1-C5 plan).
relation.W4_capability_demonstration: W4 (fo_capability_demo_prep) prepares CD-01..CD-07 and the record format for the N4 S1-C4 measured-capability artifact. S1A_READY is the point from which those demonstrations may be executed on actual hardware as non-score-bearing engineering qualification; their results become the S1-C4 record only when the owner accepts them against a frozen S1-C5 calibration plan (N4).
relation.W5: S1a produces the first H-1 data (registration inputs). The firewall keeps them in custody until LOCK-H1 and forbids every held-out output in S1a.

milestones.A: Schedule enabler only: starting engineering qualification early shortens the path to S1 -> LOCK-2 -> the controlled HW-0 / HW-RF / HW-ECR experiment in which the conditions of a conditional selection are demonstrated. The gate selects, ranks or eliminates nothing.
milestones.to_next: Milestone B needs N4 S1_READY, S1 executed, LOCK-2, Phase 1-3 data, the W5 pre-registration frozen and scored and an admitted Hall transport closure (credible set empty today, gate 3 FAIL). Milestone C additionally needs mass, power, thermal, life, startup, cathode and mission closure integrated.

compliance: no Hall transport closure, screening candidate or withdrawn 0-D number is read or used
no architecture (hall_only, rf_hall, ecr_hall) is ranked, preferred or eliminated; S1a is engineering qualification, not selection
no physical, efficiency, safety-limit or threshold value is carried; required coverage sets and class lists are PROPOSED
P5 calibration nuisance is never a design variable, map axis or gate item
reads only files inside the repository; writes only when --out is given; reads no N4 file
